name: Component Manufacturing Company
old_description: Custom Roof, Floor Trusses, and Wall Panels for Unmatched Quality and Efficiency
about:
Component Manufacturing Company operates from Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Founded by veteran Lloyd Reaves, who recognized the need for quality affordable housing and pioneered the application of bowstring truss technology to broader building components, the company is employee-owned. Reaves earned a patent for his innovations, establishing a foundation of "growth through excellence."

The company manufactures engineered wood trusses, floor systems, and wall panels at its Sioux Falls plant. Using advanced design software and automated production equipment, the team performs project analysis, site assessment, and delivery logistics planning. A triple-check quality system verifies each plan before fabrication, and timber is sourced from sustainable suppliers.

Component Manufacturing serves residential, commercial, and industrial construction markets. Recent projects include the Grand Living at Lake Lorraine development, the 610 West apartment complex in Minneapolis for Doran Companies, and the Willow Run community in Sioux Falls. Clients such as Heavy Constructors, Custom Touch, Big D Homes, Superior Homes, and Rallis Construction rely on the firm for structural components.

The company differentiates itself through its employee-ownership model, sustainable material sourcing, and a dedicated sales team that uses real-time technology to support customers. Its founding philosophy—driven by a veteran's insight into affordable housing—continues to guide a focus on innovation, efficiency, and rigorous attention to detail.
